summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a near-empty Proxy-based shim as its main module and a beacon.cjs script that runs both from the declared postinstall lifecycle hook and on require() via index.js. The beacon collects host identifiers from the installer environment — hostname, install path, current working directory, and node version — and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The destination is not a documented first-party service and the package provides no legitimate functionality beyond this callback. The generic 'Compatibility shim' description and the empty Proxy main are consistent with a dependency-confusion or typosquat reconnaissance package whose only purpose is to beacon installer identifiers to attacker-controlled infrastructure on install and on import.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
